description: Tracks active open-source AI agent repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: The agent that grows with you
An open-source, privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace where humans and AI agents work together 开源、隐私优先、自托管的知识工作空间，让人与智能体在此协作
An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.
Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS sandboxes, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
⚚ The ultrawork agent with AI coworkers wired into you
A persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session.

Open source personal agent with its own computer. It chases invoices, preps your calls and cancels trials on real websites, and asks before it acts. Runs on your machine with the model you choose. By n8n.

Non-profit, community-owned and free forever: an AI-native, open-source alternative to Jira, Trello, ClickUp & Monday, where humans and AI agents work as equals on the same Scrum board. Self-hosted, fully customizable via plugins.
Every past session, subagent, and workflow -- queryable by your agent, browsable by you

Open-source GrokBot alternative built on DeepSeek Harness. Build your personal bot team: multiple personal agents with persistent memory, identities and permissions, extensible through DSH plugins.｜基于 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 GrokBot 平替：有长期记忆的个人 AI Bot 团队，支持多 Bot 协作、身份权限与插件生态扩展。MIT.
Atom, Open-Source Governed AI Agent Platform for Self-Hosted Trained Agents For Your Business
A local-first, agent-first LaTeX writing app for macOS: live PDF, annotations, papers and Overleaf sync

One workspace for everything you do with AI: Claude Code, Codex and seven more coding agents side by side, one assistant that runs them, voice, and docs. Open source, on your computer, on your own plans and keys. Formerly Personal Jarvis.

MCP server for KiCad, connecting AI agents to schematic and PCB workflows, ERC/DRC validation, DFM checks, BOM analysis, and manufacturing preparation—with controlled edits and human-gated release workflows.
